text:
alex: Pushed a small change to the runtime to emit kernel selection telemetry. Enabled behind REDWOOD_KERNEL_TELEMETRY. Landing in staging now.

maya: Nice — what fields are we emitting?

alex: Basic set: kernel, decision_reason, seq_len, batch_size, hw_arch (gpu/cpu), kv_cache_hit, est_latency_ms, measured_latency_ms, autotune_version. Also a path_tag for short_seq/long_seq.

eli: What's the exact env var set to enable verbose traces? Can we force a kernel too for repros?

alex: Example to turn on verbose + sampling and force a kernel:
```
export REDWOOD_KERNEL_TELEMETRY=1
export REDWOOD_KERNEL_TELEMETRY_VERBOSE=1    # emits selection rationale and heuristics
export REDWOOD_KERNEL_TELEMETRY_SAMPLING=0.02  # sample 2% by default
export REDWOOD_AUTOTUNE_PROFILE=seq_len,throughput
export REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL="cu_attention_win32f"   # optional, repro mode
```

jamal: Heads-up — verbose traces add ~3-6% overhead on p50 in our microbench. Recommend <=5% sampling in prod and full verbose in staging only.

perf-bot: perf/telemetry: staging cluster selection events last hour = 12,384. avg payload ~420 bytes. Approx storage delta: +4.9MB/hr. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/telemetry/kernel-selection

maya: Can decision_reason be granular? e.g., "latency_est", "throughput_opt", "fallback_capacity", "quantized_compat" — that would make filtering easier.

alex: Yep — added those exact labels. We also emit a numeric score used by the chooser (e.g., latency_score, throughput_score) if verbose.

ci-bot: NOTE: On the wire we emit compact protobufs to keep ingress small; pipeline expands to JSON. Use REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_FORMAT=json to force JSON at source for quick debugging.

eli: Quick grep to find selection entries during local repro:
```
grep -R "kernel_selection" /var/log/redwood | tail -n 200
```

maya: For autotuner tests I'll add a sweep job that runs multiple seq_len distributions and asserts chosen path_tag matches expected (short_seq -> fast small-attn, long_seq -> chunked attention kernel).

alex: Plan: nightly autotune job on staging for 48h, collect telemetry, run regression comparer that plots measured_latency_ms vs est_latency_ms and alerts when deviation > 12%.

jamal: :eyes: Also add kv cache signals per-request — sometimes cache hit flips decision from long_seq path to short_seq. We should log kv_cache_hit_rate or kv_cache_warm boolean.

alex: Added kv_cache_hit_rate and kv_cache_warm fields. Toggling rollout to staging now. Will follow up with perf numbers in the morning.

maya: Also adding a low-overhead aggregated metric (histogram of decision reasons per kernel) so we can spot sudden spikes without scanning full logs.

alex: sweet. After staging run we can enable a 1% sampling in prod for 2 weeks and watch. If anyone wants forced repro hooks, use REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL and the PR at /prs/3456 has step-by-step.

eli: Thanks — will run a few manual repros and post results.

jamal: Don't forget to update datadog dashboards and add a nightly alert if autotune drops below baseline.

alex: noted. tagging @eng-sre to coordinate alerts.

perf-bot: summary saved: s3://redwood-telemetry/backups/kernel_selection/2026-01-14/summary-17634568.json

end.
